headline: Colonials Gain Foothold in Callahan's Passage as Expanse Rekindles
war_summary: The map has shifted since our last edition. Callahan's Passage, where every stronghold lately answered to the Wardens, now counts a lone Colonial post among its ten, while the butcher's bill mounts—564 Colonial and 690 Warden fallen inside two hours, with the morning's hourly losses still climbing. The Weathered Expanse shows seven of nine posts back under Colonial colors and two lying demolished, and it filed the war's freshest action at the moment of this dispatch; thirty-nine actions mark its day, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest again busiest. The Nevish Line's Colonial foothold has widened to three of eight posts after fifty daily actions, though the churn there has thinned to a scatter in recent hours. Stlican Shelf keeps smoldering—seven posts Colonial, one Warden, one in ruins—with fighting persisting at Briar. Palantine Berm, ablaze overnight with thirty-five actions, has fallen silent since midnight. Still the quieter maps bleed: Mooring County lost 553 Colonial and 321 Warden in two hours without a post changing hands, and Linn of Mercy's losses tilt hard against the Wardens. It is day 496; thirty-four victory towns will settle this war, and no victor is yet named.
